parameters.content:
## Telegram approval -> Drive -> YouTube

OpenShorts' Telegram bot POSTs an approved clip here (multipart: `video`, `title`, `description`, `tags`, `privacy`, `job_id`, `clip_index`, header `X-OpenShorts-Secret`).

### Before activating
1. Set `OPENSHORTS_WEBHOOK_SECRET` in n8n's environment (see `examples/n8n/selfhost`).
2. Create the credentials **Google Drive account** and **YouTube account** and select them in the two Google nodes.
3. In **Upload to Drive**, replace `PASTE_YOUR_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID_HERE` with your folder id (the part after `/folders/` in the folder's URL).

Every reply is JSON: `{ok: true, drive_file_id, drive_link, youtube_video_id, youtube_url}` or `{ok: false, error}`.

YouTube: about 6 uploads a day on the default quota, and an unaudited API project can only publish private videos.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { ok: true, drive_file_id: $('Attach clip again').first().json.drive_file_id, drive_link: $('Attach clip again').first().json.drive_link, youtube_video_id: $json.uploadId, youtube_url: 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=' + $json.uploadId } }}
={{ { ok: false, error: 'youtube upload failed', drive_file_id: $('Attach clip again').first().json.drive_file_id, drive_link: $('Attach clip again').first().json.drive_link } }}
